record_scope_reconstruction: The Taftan–Mirjaveh road passage has separate Pakistani-returnee and cargo-truck suspensions; later June trade rules do not define these initial phases.

source_checks.finding: Official broadcast identifies Taftan transit gate and joint markets, with trade and travel suspended on 23 February.
Taftan trucks resumed 7 March; pilgrim immigration had resumed earlier.
